title: OpenWOP deprecation register
description: Shape of spec/v1/deprecations.json — the index of every surface an RFC or spec annotation has deprecated in v1.x (status: deprecated), plus surfaces the v2 program proposes to deprecate but no RFC has yet (status: proposed). In v1.x the register records deprecations; it never creates one (COMPATIBILITY.md §7). It is not a wire artifact and is deliberately kept out of schemas/.

surface.description: The wire-visible name of the thing: a field path, a header, a profile id, a schema file, a prose convention.

deprecatedIn.description: Corpus or suite version, or the RFC that deprecated it. null when status is proposed.

authority.description: The RFC section or spec annotation that made (or, for proposed, would make) the deprecation.

removeIn.description: Protocol major.minor at which the surface is removed. v1.x deprecations remove no earlier than 2.0 (COMPATIBILITY.md §7).

codemod.description: Identifier of the codemod that rewrites consumers, once one exists (v2 program C.11).

file.description: Repo-relative path that documents the deprecation (or the surface, for proposed rows).

token.description: A literal substring the file must still contain; the gate fails when it drifts.
